name: kexec-tools
notes: Plain autotools; builds against the host toolchain.

name: seabios
notes: Needs iasl for the ACPI tables. Its Makefile hardcodes PYTHON=python, which Debian and Ubuntu no longer ship; override it rather than relying on a python symlink, which make's direct-exec path does not always honour.

name: optiboot
notes: Needs avr-gcc; not in the default image.

name: petitboot
notes: autotools; needs autopoint and gettext. --without-ncurses drops the UI deps.

name: syslinux
notes: Does not build with modern binutils: com32/elflink/ldlinux fails to link (verified on binutils 2.42/gcc 13). Needs distro patches or an older toolchain before CodeQL can watch a build.

name: u-boot
notes: The sandbox target builds on the host and CodeQL indexes it. -fcommon is required for revisions before ~2020: gcc 10 made -fno-common the default and dtc then fails with multiple-definition errors, which matters when checking out an old vulnerable parent. Needs python3-setuptools, efitools and SDL headers.

name: barebox
notes: Sandbox target builds most of the tree but fails generating the logo PNGs even with ImageMagick present. Not investigated further.

name: grub
notes: bootstrap pulls gnulib; needs network on first run.

name: opensbi
notes: Needs a riscv64 cross toolchain; not in the default image.

name: trusted-firmware-m
notes: Needs cmake and an arm-none-eabi toolchain.

name: mcuboot
notes: The simulator target avoids a cross toolchain.

name: coreboot
notes: Builds its own cross toolchain; slow (tens of minutes).

name: edk2
build: make -C BaseTools && . edksetup.sh && build -a X64 -t GCC5 -p MdeModulePkg/MdeModulePkg.dsc
notes: Needs submodules initialised inside edk2 itself.

name: open-iscsi
notes: Needs libisns headers, which Debian does not package. Build them from source first, or configure the iSNS support out.
